title: Display and declare application author (WAMIQ AHMAD)

requirements.summary: Show the application author name "WAMIQ AHMAD" in a visible credits/footer section on the About page without breaking responsive layout or theme readability.
acceptanceCriteria: On the About page, the footer/credits area displays the author name exactly as: "WAMIQ AHMAD".
The author name is readable on both light and dark themes and does not break the existing layout on mobile widths.

file_operations.description: Update the About page credits/footer Card to include an additional author line that displays exactly "WAMIQ AHMAD" (e.g., labeled as author) using existing Tailwind theme tokens/classes so it remains readable in light/dark and wraps cleanly on small screens.

requirements.summary: Add standard HTML head metadata declaring the application author as "WAMIQ AHMAD" while preserving existing head content.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a meta tag for author with content exactly "WAMIQ AHMAD".
No other existing meta tags (description, theme-color), title, or icons are removed.

file_operations.description: Add a standard <meta name="author" content="WAMIQ AHMAD" /> tag in the document head while keeping all existing meta tags, title, and icon links intact.
